newsitem.title: USA: PhyMatrix comfortable with Q3 estimates.
newsitem.headline: PhyMatrix comfortable with Q3 estimates.

text.p: PhyMatrix Corp said Monday it is comfortable third quarter earnings will meet or exceed analyst expectations.
Spokeswoman Michele Helm said the company was referring to the First Call consensus estimate of $0.14 per share for the October quarter. PhyMatrix lost $0.20 per share in the year earlier quarter.
"Our numbers will be released in early December," the physician practice management company said.
PhyMatrix said it has agreed to provide consulting services to Health Insurance Plan of New Jersey, the first group model health maintenance organization on the East Coast. HIP of
New Jersey said PhyMatrix was selected to assist in reorganizing the medical delivery services in its 18 health centers.
PhyMatrix also said it increased the number of physicians by signing letters of intent with 70 physician comprising seven groups. -- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.
